Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Chewbacca]]: Han Solo in the medical center of the Rebel base on Hoth in ''The Empire Strikes Back'' (1980), as he says "Laugh it up, fuzzball" to Chewbacca. The frame is the thumbnail of a four-second clip of that line.

Source: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mo3pIV1CLrQ "Laugh it up, Fuzzball"], YouTube (channel You're Gonna Need a Bigger Quote; thumbnail image [https://i.ytimg.com/vi/mo3pIV1CLrQ/maxresdefault.jpg maxresdefault.jpg], 1024 by 432 pixels, uploaded unchanged). Preserved copies: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027142548/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mo3pIV1CLrQ Internet Archive] (video page) and [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027142613/https://i.ytimg.com/vi/mo3pIV1CLrQ/maxresdefault.jpg Internet Archive] (image), 27 October 2026. SHA-256 of the uploaded file: be0b8e0ae2d27f2687bc1ca7a4889bde07da316267d43c9a75bf926facf8280b.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a single reduced-size frame from ''The Empire Strikes Back'' (1980), © Lucasfilm Ltd., used only to show the moment the card's lore refers to, beside the card on [[Jokes]], on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot replace the film or harm its market, and no free image of the scene exists.
